instruction: You are at the entrance of a bedroom, near the door step of a washroom. Turn towards your slight left and move forward. In front, you find a sheep toy. Go near that and turn towards your right. Keep moving forward and in front, you find a brown door, go near that door and turn towards your slight left. Walk through the door and you enter into a corridor. Move one step ahead and turn towards your slight left again. You find an other corridor. Walk through it and on your right, you find a staircase. Walk towards that stair case and turn towards your slight left again. Keep moving forward and in front, you find an other brown door. Go near that door and turn towards your slight right. Walk through that door, you enter into a bedroom. Move forward and turn towards your slight left again. In front, you find a glass door, go near that glass door and turn towards your slight left again. Walk through that door and stand in front of a sofa, which is on your left side. You are in your balcony and you reached your destination.
